title: JEVision block package: block.json
description: Describes a block that people share. It sits in the folder ID.jevblock next to flow.json, the steps of the block.

id.description: Three or more parts of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, joined by dots, like com.acme.sign-in. The folder of the installed package is named after it.

name.description: What the block is called in the library.

description.description: What the block does, in a sentence or two.

icon.description: Name of an SF Symbol the block is shown with, such as person.crop.circle.

version.description: Semantic version: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, with an optional -pre.release part.

license.description: Name of the license of the block, such as MIT.

minVersion.description: The oldest version of JEVision that can run the block.

inputs.description: What the block asks for each time a test uses it: one entry for every ${input.NAME} of its steps.

name.description: The NAME of ${input.NAME}: letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit.

label.description: What to call the input in the editor, when the name isn't clear enough.

default.description: What the input holds when a test leaves it out.
